head: 10 new photo and video apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These photo and video apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's Photo & Video charts this week, from RAW editors and film looks to a photo booth and a camera trick that gets kids to look at the lens.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store Photo & Video charts (paid, plus Sunday in free) this week
means: If you shoot on your iPhone, these are new camera and editing apps people in the US are paying for right now.
todo: Read what each app needs first: Moxie only edits Apple ProRAW photos from an iPhone Pro, and Alpha Shutter only works with compatible Sony cameras.

list.name: Moxie - RAW Photo Editor
list.what: A RAW photo editor with ready-made looks and masks; it needs an iPhone Pro that shoots Apple ProRAW.

list.name: LayerLoops
list.what: A camera app where you draw shapes and record live video into them, layer by layer.

list.name: Lil Booth
list.what: A photo booth that takes four photos in a row and saves the strip to Photos.

list.name: LAB Cam Pro
list.what: A film camera and darkroom that develops your RAW photos through film stocks like Portra 400.

list.name: GiggleCam: Say Cheese Camera
list.what: Plays silly animations next to the lens so kids look at the camera; on iPhone Duo they show on the back screen.

list.name: Alpha Shutter
list.what: A Bluetooth remote for compatible Sony cameras, with timelapse and long-exposure tools.

list.name: Local Video Upscaler
list.what: Upscales old or low-resolution videos to HD or 4K on your device, without uploading them.

list.name: Matrix Dot Camera
list.what: A toy camera that shoots 96 by 128 pixel dot-matrix photos and prints them on Bluetooth thermal printers.

list.name: Heliodial: Sun Path & Position
list.what: Shows the sun's path, golden hour and blue hour for any place and date on one dial.

list.name: Sunday: Photo & Video Editor
list.what: A photo and video editor with presets made by creator Alexa Jean Brown and a feed planner.
